messages:
emma_sec: Quick question — we keep hitting ambiguity around archival checkpoints and who can request a KMS unwrap for historical logs. thinking we need a short playbook and an RBAC role for analysts.
raj_infra: Agreed. Current flow is too heavy for triage but too permissive for long-term access.
oliver_sre: Can you sketch what 'short playbook' means? timeboxes? ticket gating? approvals? :thinking_face:
tess_analyst: For vuln triage we often need a 7-day window to inspect an archived chunk. If we make it 7d ephemeral keys, that's probably fine. also want masked-view by default.
emma_sec: Proposal: create role `analyst_view_temp` with 1) request via ticketing bot, 2) auto-expire unwrap token 8 hours, 3) audit-bot logs and notification to sec-mailing-list.
ben_product: Sounds reasonable. How will this interact with SIEM exports? we don't want someone pulling full raw exports under that role.
raj_infra: Good catch. Make role scoped to read-only access against the archival checkpoint API, not the raw export endpoint. We'll enforce scope = ["archive:read_view"] and deny export endpoints.
oliver_sre: Implementation notes: KMS unwrap requests must go through kms-proxy service. It issues a short-lived plaintext token to the archive reader, and the proxy emits an audit event. Suggest 4-hour max by default, adjustable per ticket.
Tess_analyst: Would we allow extension? e.g., ongoing incident might need multiple extensions.
emma_sec: Extensions allowed but must be explicit in ticket with justification and require second approver (oncall or sec lead). no silent renewals.
audit-bot: [audit] KMS unwrap requested by tess_analyst for archive-checkpoint:cp-2023-10-11, duration=4h, ticket=SEC-6242
raj_infra: Add programmatic guardrails: if unwrap_count for checkpoint > 3 within 30d, auto-escalate and require manager approval. reduces repeated mass-unwraps.
ben_product: Also add data minimization: the archive reader should only return minimal fields for triage. Example whitelisting: timestamp, event_type, user_id (hashed), service, short_message. No full payload blobs without additional approval.
oliver_sre: We should codify this in the ticket template. Quick template draft:\n\n```\nTitle: Archive access request — [checkpoint id]\nPurpose: short justification (vuln triage / investigation)\nScope: list of checkpoint ids, time range\nDuration: requested hours (max 8)\nRequested-by: <analyst>\nApprover: <sec lead / oncall>\nData fields needed: (choose from whitelist)\n```\n\nemma_sec: +1 to that. Also include a checkbox for \"forensic hold\" which if selected triggers retention freeze and different workflow (legal + sec).
tess_analyst: What about SIEM export pipelines? If we need to re-run a filter for triage, can analyst re-run on a pre-scrubbed partition?
raj_infra: Will permit re-run only via a sandboxed query service that returns scrubbed results, not raw export. All queries pinned to a snapshot id and audited. No direct re-run against export sinks.
ben_product: How will we alert on suspicious unwrap patterns?
emma_sec: Rule ideas: unwrap by non-manager analyst during off-hours, >2 unwraps for same checkpoint by different people, or large byte read > X MB. All fire an alert to #eng-security and raise a high-priority ticket.
Tess_analyst: Can we add a small CLI for requesting access that pre-fills the ticket and attaches the analyst's justification? reduces friction.
raj_infra: Yep — infra will add `ai-archive-request` CLI that opens SEC ticket and pings approvers. CLI will include the desired fields and checksum of checkpoint.
oliver_sre: We'll also add an automated retention-check: if checkpoint is older than retention_cutoff + 30d, deny unwrap unless sec lead overrides with explicit reason.
emma_sec: Next steps: raj to draft RBAC role and kms-proxy change, oliver to add monitoring rules and audit-bot log enrichment, tess to test the ticket template, ben to confirm product constraints around export access. I'll own the playbook doc.
raj_infra: On it — I'll drop a PR for role + policy and include the sample IAM binding. ETA EOD Thurs.
ben_product: I'll validate with privacy/legal about the minimal field whitelist.
Tess_analyst: I'll test the ticket flow and report back.
audit-bot: [audit] Role created `analyst_view_temp` (draft) by raj_infra at 1758010200
emma_sec: Thanks team. keeping this tight should help triage speed while keeping retention/audit hygiene. :thumbsup:
raj_infra: small snippet for the IAM binding we'll use: `roles/archive.viewer::members = [\"group:analysts@redwood.com\"]` — will add condition on `request.source == \"ticketing-bot\"`.
oliver_sre: Perfect. Once PRs land we'll run a canary with two checkpoints and verify alerts.
